method: A second search by hand, for Oct 14-21, 2026, of what the first left out: restaurant promotions, sales at the online stores not yet searched, and regular deals in the areas not yet swept. Same rules: web search only, each finding cross-checked on the company's page or by two dated sources; the search tool allowed 200 searches per turn across the three searches. Slomp's side: the four site builds of Oct 14, the first on the round-1 fixes. The deal-site posts found were replayed through Slomp's own parsers and filters, on main (the round-1 fixes) and on this change.
